title: 第十五章我有一剑可撼筑基第十六章梅花映雪寒
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 张守安抬头望着朝自己冲来的黑色掌影，握着剑柄的手愈发攥紧几分。
在几秒内，他迅速做出判断。
不行，完全接不下来。
他脑中再次思考办法，不过在无数次设想后，只得出一个办法。
系统，给我推演。
【检测到宿主要求，开始推演】
【自动为宿主提升功法等级，目前等级：筑基】
【推演花费：1000道行值次】
张守安一阵心疼，自己刚才好不容易杀了八九个练气中期和后期的弟子，再算上之前剩下的100多道行值，才堪堪凑够1000多的道行值。
本来打算试着推演几个练气品级的轻功和心法，这回倒是好了，一下就花没了。
计划赶不上变化，系统推演！……张守安心里大喊，系统终于开始。
【结合宿主情况，开始推演。】
【功法名称：化血煞剑（筑基）（入门）】
系统，加满……张守安心里焦急地喊了一声，却是弹出提示。
【道行值不足】
该死……张守安骂了一声，由于化血煞剑还在入门，所以系统不会像之前那般，给出使用的介绍，它只能花时间自己摸索。
可是那只手掌已经来到了他面前，他哪里还有时间。
他咬紧牙关，浑身已覆盖白气，只希望能用这护体罡气来抵挡一瞬，为自己争取一点时间。
没见过这么憋屈的，功法都学会了，但就是不知道怎么使，要是挡不下来，真就完蛋了。
这时，空中传来一道笑声：“我看你资质不错，真是个炼尸的好材料。”
“你放心，等你死后，我会使用好你这个好资源的。”
md，真是玩脱了……张守安心里唏嘘，但那只手掌已经撞了上来。
悬殊的实力差，瞬间在此刻显露无疑，张守安用剑格挡，身上的血管已经爆开了几根，双眼已经沾满猩红。
他额头青筋暴起，已经使出了全部实力。
突然，一道“咔嚓”声自他手中传来，他低头一看，手中长剑已经抵挡不住压力，从中间断裂开来。
“砰！”剑刃从中间断开，也是将张守安的全部希望断开。
他吐出一口鲜血，将手里断剑一丢，只能靠着白青罡气和金刚锻体法苦苦坚持。
可是压迫越来越大，他的身躯也是“扑通”一声跪在了地上。
而后是骨头碎裂的“咔嚓”声，还有他痛苦的闷哼。
他吐出了一大口鲜血，眼里已经满是绝望。
就要这么死了吗？死后都不安宁，还要被炼尸，供人使用。
他带血的嘴角惨然一笑，似乎接受了宿命。
可突然，他身上似有所感。
那种感觉隐隐约约，就像……他脸上出现了一抹迷茫，但身上的那种亢奋已经跃跃欲试。
随之而来的，是地面上的血液，他们竟然腾空而起，漂浮在自己眼前。
他满眼迷茫，但只觉得身上的压力越来越轻，就像有什么在帮他抵挡一样。
虽然他不知道发生了什么，不过在场的众人却是目瞪口呆，因为他们看见，那个原本快要惨死的身影之后，竟然……竟然……
竟凭空出现了一把血剑，而它的规模，此刻还在不断扩大，四周的血液不断从散落的尸体上掠出，漂浮在空中，慢慢聚集，流淌起来。
content_en:
Zhang Shou'an looked up at the black palm figure rushing towards him, and the hand holding the sword hilt tightened a little more.
Within seconds, he made a quick decision.
No, I can't take it at all.
He thought about the solution again in his mind, but after countless thoughts, he only came up with one solution.
System, give me the deduction.
[Host request detected, start deduction]
[Automatically improve the skill level for the host, current level: Foundation Establishment]
[Cost of deduction: 1000 Taoxing values]
Zhang Shou'an felt distressed for a while. He had just managed to kill eight or nine disciples who were in the middle and late stages of Qi training. Counting the more than 100 Tao Xing values ​​left before, he could barely make up more than 1,000 Tao Xing values.
I originally planned to try to deduce several qinggong and mental techniques of Qi training level, but this time it was better, and it was all gone in one go.
The plan cannot keep up with the changes, and the system is deduced! ...Zhang Shou'an shouted in his heart that the system finally started.
[Daoxing value-1000]
[Combining the situation of the host, start the deduction. 】
[Name of the skill: Blood Transforming Sword (Foundation Building) (Introduction)]
System, refill... Zhang Shou'an shouted anxiously in his heart, but a prompt popped up.
【Insufficient Daoxing Value】
Damn it... Zhang Shou'an cursed. Since the Blood Sword was still getting started, the system would not give instructions on how to use it like before. It could only spend time exploring on its own.
But that palm had already come to him, so he didn't have time.
He gritted his teeth and his whole body was covered with white energy. He just hoped that he could use this body-protecting energy to resist for a moment and buy himself some time.
I have never seen anyone so frustrated. I have learned all the techniques, but I just don’t know how to use them. If I can’t stop him, I’m really doomed.
At this time, a laughter came from the air: "I think you have good qualifications. You are really a good material for corpse refining."
"Don't worry, after you die, I will make good use of this good resource of yours."
md, I really lost my temper... Zhang Shou'an felt sad, but the palm had already hit him.
The disparity in strength was clearly revealed at this moment. Zhang Shou'an blocked with his sword. Several blood vessels on his body had burst and his eyes were already stained with scarlet.
Veins popped out on his forehead, and he had used all his strength.
Suddenly, a "click" sound came from his hand. He looked down and saw that the sword in his hand could no longer withstand the pressure and broke in the middle.
"Bang!" The blade was severed from the middle, which also severed all Zhang Shou'an's hopes.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, threw away the broken sword in his hand, and could only rely on the Bai Qing Gang Qi and the Vajra Body Strengthening Technique to persevere.
But the pressure became more and more intense, and his body fell to his knees with a "plop".
Then there was the "click" sound of broken bones, and his painful groan.
He spat out a large mouthful of blood, his eyes filled with despair.
Are you going to die like this? There is no peace after death, and the body has to be refined for human use.
He smiled miserably at the corner of his bloody mouth, seeming to accept his fate.
But suddenly, he seemed to feel something.
The feeling was vague, like... There was a trace of confusion on his face, but the excitement in his body was already eager to try.
What followed was blood on the ground, and they actually rose into the air and floated in front of their eyes.
His eyes were full of confusion, but he felt that the pressure on his body was getting lighter and lighter, as if something was helping him resist.
Although he didn't know what happened, everyone present was stunned, because after they saw the figure who was about to die tragically, he actually... actually...
A blood sword appeared out of thin air, and its size was still expanding at this moment. The blood around it was constantly snatched from the scattered corpses, floating in the air, slowly gathering, and flowing.
